summary: We are developing a map that addresses the challenge of human adaptation to an unknown territory; it will serve as a guide for plotting safe routes for humans to traverse.
details: This is an interactive, layer-based map incorporating features such as terrain relief and thermal inertia, developed using the software Unity. It allows users to navigate to any point on the planet, where they can access strategic locations containing data recorded by robots.
